subject: Initial commit.
prompt: Make me a simulation game in pygame. it is a game of life. This game will play out with 3 types of entities. Plants, herbivores and carnivores. A plant will grow until eaten. A herbivore and carivore will start with high health, when it eats, it gains health. Every turn causes it to lose health. At 0 hp they die. Carnivores gain HP by eating herbivores. Herbivores gain HP by eating plants. Herbivores run away from carnivores. Carnivores run towards herbivores to eat them.
